mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_order WHERE deleted = FALSE AND status = 'CONFIRMED'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(settlement_total_amount), 0) FROM sales_order WHERE deleted = FALSE AND status = 'CONFIRMED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer WHERE deleted = FALSE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM supplier WHERE deleted = FALSE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_sku WHERE deleted = FALSE

SELECT item.product_name_snapshot AS name, COALESCE(SUM(item.settlement_line_amount), 0) AS amount FROM sales_order_item item JOIN sales_order so ON so.id = item.order_id WHERE item.deleted = FALSE AND so.deleted = FALSE AND so.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND so.created_at >= #{startTime} AND so.created_at < #{endTime} GROUP BY item.spu_id, item.product_name_snapshot ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity), 0) FROM inventory_balance WHERE deleted = FALSE
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sku_id) FROM inventory_balance WHERE deleted = FALSE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM warehouse WHERE deleted = FALSE AND status = 'ENABLED'

SELECT w.name AS warehouseName, COALESCE(SUM(b.quantity), 0) AS quantity FROM inventory_balance b JOIN warehouse w ON w.id = b.warehouse_id WHERE b.deleted = FALSE AND w.deleted = FALSE GROUP BY b.warehouse_id, w.name ORDER BY quantity DESC

SELECT (b.quantity - b.reserved_quantity) AS availableQuantity, t.warn_min AS warnMin, t.warn_max AS warnMax FROM inventory_warning_threshold t LEFT JOIN inventory_balance b ON b.warehouse_id = t.warehouse_id AND b.sku_id = t.sku_id AND b.deleted = FALSE WHERE t.deleted = FALSE UNION ALL SELECT (b.quantity - b.reserved_quantity) AS availableQuantity, CAST(NULL AS numeric) AS warnMin, CAST(NULL AS numeric) AS warnMax FROM inventory_balance b WHERE b.deleted = FALSE AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM inventory_warning_threshold t WHERE t.deleted = FALSE AND t.warehouse_id = b.warehouse_id AND t.sku_id = b.sku_id )

SELECT w.name AS warehouseName, COALESCE(SUM(b.quantity), 0) AS quantity, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(m.quantity) FROM inventory_movement m WHERE m.deleted = FALSE AND m.warehouse_id = w.id AND m.movement_type IN #{mt} AND m.occurred_at >= #{startTime} AND m.occurred_at < #{endTime}), 0) AS todayOutboundQuantity FROM warehouse w LEFT JOIN inventory_balance b ON b.warehouse_id = w.id AND b.deleted = FALSE WHERE w.deleted = FALSE AND w.status = 'ENABLED' GROUP BY w.id, w.name ORDER BY quantity DESC

SELECT to_char(d, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS date, to_char(d, 'MM-DD') AS label, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_order so WHERE so.deleted = FALSE AND so.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND (so.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date = d::date), 0) AS orders, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(so.settlement_total_amount) FROM sales_order so WHERE so.deleted = FALSE AND so.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND (so.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date = d::date), 0) AS sales, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase_order po WHERE po.deleted = FALSE AND (po.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date = d::date), 0) AS purchaseOrders, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(po.total_amount) FROM purchase_order po WHERE po.deleted = FALSE AND (po.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date = d::date), 0) AS purchaseAmounts, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.movement_type IN #{mt} THEN m.quantity ELSE -m.quantity END) FROM inventory_movement m WHERE m.deleted = FALSE AND (m.occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date <= d::date), 0) AS inventoryQuantity, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(m.quantity) FROM inventory_movement m WHERE m.deleted = FALSE AND m.movement_type IN #{mt} AND (m.occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date = d::date), 0) AS inboundQuantity, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(m.quantity) FROM inventory_movement m WHERE m.deleted = FALSE AND m.movement_type IN #{mt} AND (m.occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date = d::date), 0) AS outboundQuantity FROM generate_series(#{startDate}::date, #{endDate}::date, INTERVAL '1 day') AS gs(d) ORDER BY d
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase_order WHERE deleted = FALSE
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM purchase_order WHERE deleted = FALSE
